{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Compute the fraction of patients with SEVERE baseline disease
total_patients = len(df)
severe_patients = df['severity'].value_counts().get('severe', 0)
fraction_severe = severe_patients / total_patients

# Print the exact values as computed
print(f"total_patients = {total_patients}")
print(f"severe_patients = {severe_patients}")
print(f"fraction_severe = {fraction_severe}")"}
